note: Measured on allowlisted public NBA results. Recent selection excludes the original archived test and the historical confirmation period. Historical gains are small and do not establish future accuracy; prospective promotion is still required.

recent_research.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
recent_research.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

recent_research.note: Recent-data research is separate from the original archived test. Selection uses 2022 through June 2025 only; subsequent completed-season confirmation does not select candidates. Development gains remain optimistic. No live weights change without the independent prospective gate.

confirmation.note: Historical confirmation of specifications selected on pre-July 2025 results, both trained on the same recent history. The current season and original archived test are excluded. This is not prospective promotion evidence.
